0022600027.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (4-4, 3-1 at home, 6th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 2 games back) are on a two-game losing streak as they host the Philadelphia 76ers (8-1, 1st in the East and Atlantic, on a five-game winning streak and 4-0 on the road). Cleveland trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 114-106 loss in Philadelphia on October 22, though the Cavaliers won all four meetings in 2025-26. Jaylon Tyson is out with an ankle sprain for Cleveland, while Jarrett Allen (knee), Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness) and Tyrese Proctor (ankle) are day-to-day and gametime decisions; Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Adem Bona is day-to-day with a head injury.
